title: Graveyard Keeper 2
provenance: Reported by JarlaxleXenocide (upstream#237, 2026-09-27), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, KLYC-Box 0.9.38, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r9, environment in D3DMetal mode with the vcrun2022 recipe, rated 4 of 5 after 10 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Released September 2026. Reported playable on D3DMetal with minor frame drops while exploring the world; the reporter found DXVK much worse, with serious frame drops. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Minor frame drops and stutter while exploring the world (reported on an M5 Pro, D3DMetal, engine r9).
knownIssues.fix: none known. DXVK is worse for it, per the same report.

d3dmetal.detail: playable with minor frame drops while exploring (reported, M5 Pro)
